approved_scope.title: Share one read cache across worktrees when the checkout path runs through a symlink
approved_scope.description: Share one read cache across worktrees when the checkout path runs through a symlink
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-119 already requires the cache under the Git common directory shared by worktrees; this resolves that directory to its canonical path so a symlinked checkout path (macOS /var -> /private/var) names the same file. No contract text changes.
acceptance_criteria: a_second_worktree_reads_warm_from_the_shared_cache passes on macOS: the main and a linked worktree resolve the same persistent cache path even when the checkout path runs through a symlink.
